verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible agent read access to CRM data, explicitly naming contacts, deals and engagements. The probe confirms the server exists, and connected inboxes log email replies to the CRM, so an agent can pull open deals, emails and activity history to assemble a pre-meeting brief. Missing for 10: endpoint- or tool-level docs for retrieving deal pipelines and email engagement history, filtering by account or time window, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent compiling such a brief.
